Class BlockPalette

java.lang.Object
dev.despical.pixelpainter.image.BlockPalette
public final class BlockPalette extends Object
Resolves configured material colors and performs perceptual nearest-color matching.

Loading runs on the server thread because it resolves Bukkit materials and creates canonical block-data strings. Unknown materials are skipped for cross-version palettes; unsafe blocks, invalid colors and unavailable explicit inclusions reject the candidate palette.

Matching uses cached Oklab coordinates without world access. The entry list is copied. Treat each entry's coordinate array as read-only when sharing a palette with image workers; subsets reuse those entries.

Supported transparent cubes include stable ice and leaves; glass is never used. Leaves use persistent block data to prevent natural decay. Gravity blocks and block entities are rejected before a candidate can reach the painting service.
